items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: I always did dance with Bob Bill and Dixon Land music and jazz music.

ctx.x: You ought to say something. You ought to say something. What kind of music do you prefer yourself?

Well, really, I love jazz music, Dixon Land music, I like dance music. Of course, that's what I've been following all my days. I always did dance with Bob Bill and Dixon Land music and jazz music. And jazz at that time was hard to go so.
